approved_claims.performance: IQ2 averaged 43.643 generation tok/s versus 38.030 for Q2; IQ2 was 14.759% faster by reciprocal decode-rate comparison and used 1,583 MiB less sampled peak VRAM.
approved_claims.quality: Q2 passed 10 of 24 objective tasks versus 9 for IQ2; exact McNemar p = 1.0 did not support a directional general-quality claim.
approved_claims.context: The tested 16K IQ2 configuration processed 12,831 prompt tokens plus 128 completion tokens at 39.201 generation tok/s with 11.119-second mean TTFT and 2,507 MiB minimum sampled free VRAM.
approved_claims.mtp: MTP improved 256-token throughput by 47.284% for prose and 92.651% for Python code, but deterministic prose diverged at generated token 16, so MTP remains off by default.
approved_claims.software: The repository passes 61 offline tests and a Windows Python 3.11/3.14 CI matrix.

publication_rules: Link the GitHub repository and Hugging Face report.
Do not claim general model quality or universal 16K capacity.
Do not describe MTP as transparent or output-equivalent.
Do not publish private contact details, learning files, local paths, or model weights.
Verify the signed-in account and exact rendered content before each final submission.
Obtain separate action-time approval for LinkedIn, X, and any optional community post.
excluded_actions: creating or moving the v0.1.0 Git tag
uploading model weights or runtime artifacts

validation.visual_review: all exact text, metrics, warning, and repository URL verified
